_comment: USD price per 1,000,000 tokens. Rates verified against Anthropic's published pricing as of `_ratesAsOf`; prices change over time — edit freely and update that date. Cache rates are derived from `input` via cacheMultipliers (Anthropic standard: read 0.1x, 5-min write 1.25x, 1-hour write 2x). Costs in the receipt are labelled 'estimated equivalent API cost'; on a Pro/Max subscription you don't pay per token.
